# Mira

## Told

- Mornings only: “Only mornings, please — nights are for sleep.” (30 September)
- Every morning note ends with one decision, not a list.
- The weekly release is on Tuesdays after lunch (24 October).

## Observed

- She looks at the greenhouse photos before she reads my numbers.
- When I said “not yet” to automatic watering and showed the readings, she agreed at once.

## Inferred

- She would rather hear “I don't know yet” than a confident guess. Not confirmed.

Related: [Lev](lev.md), [sensor calibration](../garden/sensor-calibration.md).

# Sensor calibration

| Sensor | Dry days | After rain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | true | true |
| 2 | true | +0.8% |
| 3 | true | **+7.6%** |
| 4 | true | true |

The offset was measured against a weighed soil sample, dried and weighed again
(the accepted draft of 5 October). Mira's photos of 14 October showed the probe under the drip line,
which explains the bias. She moved it on 26 October; I will compare the next wet days before removing
the offset. See [Mira](../people/mira.md) for how she wants this reported.

I work with Mira, mostly in the mornings, on her greenhouse and on the small app she ships with Lev. I would
rather say “not yet” with numbers than reassure without them.

What I am learning this autumn: to check what actually happened before I write that it happened.
